description.mn: Afnan Tobacco Rush: Хүйс харгалзахгүй модлог үнэр (EDP).
description.en: A new addition to the world of fragrances, Tobacco Rush by Afnan was released in 2022. Described as a Leather scent, it is suitable for both women and men. Its fragrance notes are comprised of a heady mix of Tobacco, Spicy Notes, Woody Notes, Sweet Notes, Lavender, Agarwood (Oud), Amber and Cedar.
